tabs.note: Western astrology. The changeover dates move by a day in some years and some sources. Symbol colours show the element: red for fire, green for earth, gold for air and blue for water.

tabs.name: Chinese zodiac
tabs.note: Each year starts at Lunar New Year, between 21 January and 20 February, so early-year birthdays belong to the previous animal. 2026 is the Year of the Horse.

tabs.name: Chinese animal years
tabs.note: Each animal year starts on Lunar New Year and runs to the day before the next one, so a birthday in January or early February may belong to the year before. Type a year in the search box to look it up.
